manifest_sampling.method: whole claim groups, deterministic seed ordering, greedy native-label proportion matching; no row truncation

sampling.bias_disclosure: Greedy native-label proportion matching is a development diagnostic sample, not a uniform group sample or a population-representative split estimate. Seeded hashes break ties; mixed-label/group-size composition can be preferentially selected. Compare population and selected group diagnostics.

protocol.measured_cost: not available unless explicitly supplied by offline scorer

intervals.method: deterministic claim-group percentile bootstrap; Wilson intervals above assume independent Bernoulli observations

prediction_metadata.checkpoint_semantics: Incremental completed batches; exact replay coverage required; no automatic resume or retry

pair.claim: All hematopoietic stem cells segregate their chromosomes randomly.
pair.evidence: Sequential administration of 5-chloro-2-deoxyuridine and 5-iodo-2-deoxyuridine indicated that all HSCs segregate their chromosomes randomly.

pair.claim: Rapid up-regulation and higher basal expression of interferon-induced genes increase survival of granule cell neurons that are infected by West Nile virus.
pair.evidence: By transducing cortical neurons with genes that were expressed more highly in granule cell neurons, we identified three interferon-stimulated genes (ISGs; Ifi27, Irg1 and Rsad2 (also known as Viperin)) that mediated the antiviral effects against different neurotropic viruses.

pair.claim: Subcutaneous fat depots undergo extensive browning processes after cold exposure.
pair.evidence: During cold-induced 'browning' of subcutaneous fat, most 'beige' adipocytes stem from de novo–differentiated adipocytes.

pair.claim: CX3CR1 on the Th2 cells impairs T cell survival
pair.evidence: We found that CX3CR1 signaling promoted T(H)2 survival in the inflamed lungs, and injection of B cell leukemia/lymphoma-2 protein (BCl-2)-transduced CX3CR1-deficient T(H)2 cells into CX3CR1-deficient mice restored asthma.

pair.claim: High cardiopulmonary fitness causes increased mortality rate.
pair.evidence: CONCLUSION Low fitness in adolescents and adults is common in the US population and is associated with an increased prevalence of CVD risk factors.

pair.claim: In adult tissue, most T cells are memory T cells.
pair.evidence: Whereas adult tissues contain a predominance of memory T cells, in pediatric blood and tissues the main subset consists of naive recent thymic emigrants, with effector memory T cells (T(EM)) found only in the lungs and small intestine.

pair.claim: Increased microtubule acetylation repairs LRRK2 Roc-COR domain mutation induced locomotor deficits.
pair.evidence: In vitro, increasing microtubule acetylation using deacetylase inhibitors or the tubulin acetylase αTAT1 prevents association of mutant LRRK2 with microtubules, and the deacetylase inhibitor trichostatin A (TSA) restores axonal transport.

pair.claim: Increased vessel density along with a reduction in fibrosis decreases the efficacy of chemotherapy treatments.
pair.evidence: We tested whether the delivery and efficacy of gemcitabine in the mice could be improved by coadministration of IPI-926, a drug that depletes tumor-associated stromal tissue by inhibition of the Hedgehog cellular signaling pathway. The combination therapy produced a transient increase in intratumoral vascular density and intratumoral concentration of gemcitabine, leading to transient stabilization of disease.

pair.claim: LDL cholesterol has no involvement in the development of cardiovascular disease.
pair.evidence: BACKGROUND LDL cholesterol has a causal role in the development of cardiovascular disease.

pair.claim: Occupancy of ribosomes by IncRNAs mirror 5 0-UTRs
pair.evidence: Here, we show that classical noncoding RNAs and 5' UTRs show the same ribosome occupancy as lincRNAs, demonstrating that ribosome occupancy alone is not sufficient to classify transcripts as coding or noncoding.
